event_detail: Kettle: the open gripper comes down right over the kettle at 4.8 s (over the lid, handle not between the fingers), then at 6.4 s it is high above the counter with the fingers closed and the kettle still standing on the counter.
evidence: Wrist camera: at 3.2 s the kettle is approached, at 4.8 s it fills the view just below the open fingers; at 6.4 s the camera is well above the counter, the finger pads look closed together, and the whole kettle is seen sitting on the counter below. Right shoulder view at 6.4 s shows the arm raised and the kettle still on the counter right of the stove. The fingers might also just be repositioning, so confidence is moderate.
